title: Brightwater Museum exhibition press release
brief: Write the press release page for the Brightwater Maritime Museum's new exhibition "Tides of Trade", for the museum website's press room. Headings: "At a glance", "About the exhibition", "Visiting", "Programs" and "Press contact". At a glance: opens to the public on 2026-11-14, closes 2027-05-09, 140 objects from 12 countries, curated by Dr. Rasmus Lindholm. About: it follows spice, tea and cotton routes between 1600 and 1850 through original ship ledgers, navigation instruments and a full-size reconstruction of a cargo hold; the centerpiece is the 1783 log of the brig Hesper, shown publicly for the first time. Visiting: admission 18 dollars for adults, 14 dollars for seniors, free for children under 12 and museum members; open Tuesday to Sunday 10:00 to 17:00, and until 20:00 on Thursdays; the exhibition is fully step-free. Programs: an opening gala on 2026-11-13 at 18:30, tickets 120 dollars; a curator talk every first Saturday at 14:00; free school visits for groups of up to 40 students, booked at schools@brightwatermuseum.example. Press contact: Yvette Marchand, press@brightwatermuseum.example, 555-0178. Formal but inviting, one page.
